title: EvoVerification
description: Exit contract for m_evo_verify: the verifier seat's mechanical re-measurement of one candidate. All numbers must be recomputable from verify_run_ref; a declared artifact_audit re-derives held_in/held_out counts from the referenced run and fails the mission if they disagree. The verifier holds the held-out manifest; its content never appears here beyond aggregate counts.

verify_run_ref.description: Run directory (relative to runs/) containing the raw evaluation outputs backing every number below.

regressions.description: Task ids that passed under the base genome but fail under the candidate.

verdict.description: confirmed: held-in gain > 0 and no held-out regression; not_confirmed: no measurable gain; regression: any held-out regression. Thresholds per PREREG.

verified_by.description: seat:<agent_key> — must hold the evo_verifier role and must differ from the proposer seat; RBAC-checked.

gain_pp.description: v2: 100 * (passed_candidate - passed_base) / tasks_total. v3 continuous: 100 * (fitness_candidate - fitness_base). Recomputed by audit.

fitness_base.description: v3 only: mean baseline-centered score of in_fitness tasks.
